description: Extracts mandatory and rated evaluation criteria from a public-sector Request for Resumes (RFR)

fieldSchema.name: RequestForResumes
fieldSchema.description: Evaluation criteria for a staffing request

Title.description: The full role title after the request ID, e.g. 'Generative AI Developer'. It may wrap onto a second line; include every word

MandatoryCriteria.description: Each pass/fail mandatory requirement, in order

Text.description: Full requirement text exactly as written

Skills.description: Each named technology, product, tool or practice in this requirement, one per item, exactly as written. Include acronyms and practice names such as CI/CD, MLOps or SIEM when the text names them. Do not include generic phrases such as 'data pipelines' or 'detection rules'

MinimumYears.description: Minimum years of experience stated in this requirement (e.g. 'Minimum 3 years' -> 3). Leave empty if no number of years is stated

Text.description: Requirement text exactly as written, without the points

Skills.description: Each named technology, product, tool or practice in this requirement, one per item, exactly as written. Include acronyms and practice names such as CI/CD, MLOps or SIEM when the text names them. Do not include generic phrases such as 'data pipelines' or 'detection rules'

TargetYears.description: Years of experience stated for full points (e.g. '3 years for full points' -> 3). Leave empty if not stated
